note: Every approved look reference of Brix Town, in one list (ADR-0061). Files live in Art/Reference/<Category>/ and are named <Category><Subject>[_<Variant>].<ext> in PascalCase, so a name says what it is. 'locks' is what the reference decides; 'decision' the ADR and the owner's approval; 'made_by' the script that renders it; 'models' what the game is built from or measured against with it; 'status' proposed when it waits for the owner's approval; 'issues' what is seen wrong in it and not mended, for the owner to judge; 'was' the old names. 'gaps' are references a category still lacks. Tools/reference_catalog.py checks this file against the folders and writes Art/Reference/index.html; run it after any change here.

references.title: The old-town alley at every hour and in every weather
references.locks: The look of the world (the old-town alley of style test 02: matte mottled plaster and stone, soft rounded forms, W1-W8) at morning, midday and dusk; at night with the lamps on, and with them off under a full and a new moon; and by day in cloud, rain, fog and snow. No haze at midday. Rain and snow fall, puddles lie with rings where the drops fall into them, and the snow lies, only where the sky is open over them: never under the passage's roof. Only the light and the weather change between them. Rain as the game's (Game/README Weather): thin pale streaks (4.5 mm), the open paving darker with a faint sheen in half-metre cells, soft-edged dark puddles with a little mirror and faint grey rings; none under a roof or arch.
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: "approved" (a reference shows every setting, not one; replaces WorldLook and the alley of WorldHours; ADR-0061); its rain redone as the game's (the owner, 2026-11-26: "Yes, both"; drops half as wide); snow as small round balls, the near ones up to 30% smaller (the owner, 2026-11-26)
references.made_by: Tools/blender/hours_50.py (WASTED_PLACE=alley), on the alley of Tools/blender/old_town_04.py
models: Game/Source/BrixTown/Private/BrixLight.cpp and Game/Config/DefaultGame.ini [/Script/BrixTown.BrixLight] (the sun, sky, haze, the eye)
issues: The cream banners across the alley catch the gate lamp at dusk and at night and read as bright blocks.
People are lit like everything else: nobody stands out under a lamp at night.

references.title: The sky and its clouds at every hour and in every weather
references.locks: The sky over the town, seen from Market Square over the roofs: blue overhead fading to the pale haze at the horizon by day, warm towards the low sun at dusk, the night's dark blue with the town's glow low down; clouds as soft heaps on one layer about 1.2 km up, flat underneath and rounded on top, lit on the sun's side and shaded underneath, pink at dusk, lit from below by the town's lamps at night; how much of the sky they cover follows the weather (clear 0.36, cloudy 0.62, rain 0.97, fog 0.55, snow 0.92); at night the stars, the Milky Way and the full moon's disc. No planet (ADR-0064).
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: "move to sky and cloud system"; ADR-0014 (the sky and clouds), ADR-0023 (the night sky), ADR-0064 (no planet); the owner, 2026-11-26: "leave the realistic clouds as they were", then "Approve, go to Market Square"; snow as small round balls, the near ones up to 30% smaller (the owner, 2026-11-26)

issues: The lying snow is laid in 25 cm squares: their steps show where it meets the fountain's base and the stalls.
The moon's disc is set where the camera sees it, not where the moonlight comes from.

references.title: Market Square from its arcade at every hour and in every weather
references.locks: Market Square seen from inside its near arcade: the far arcade, the fountain, the stalls' corner and the tree through three arches; sunlit paving bright, the arcade's shade lit by the light the sunlit paving and stone throw back (readable, about 1.5 stops under the sun, not black); lanterns lit in the arcade by day as approved, warm pools at dusk and with the lamps on; the full moon lighting the open paving past the arches, a new moon only starlight; cloud, rain (puddles with rings on the open paving), fog and snow (lying only under open sky), none of it under the arcade.
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: "market square should be separate reference and have all hours of it's own" and "fix it's mid day - shadow areas are too dark, looks like bounce light is missing"; ADR-0061; the owner, 2026-11-26: "Approve, next place"; snow as small round balls, the near ones up to 30% smaller (the owner, 2026-11-26)

references.title: The street at every hour and in every weather
references.locks: The example street of real lots from World/ (building_kit_07): the café's awning and its lit windows, the facades' relief raked by the sun, the far rows closing it in haze; street lamps lit at dusk and on the lamp-lit night, dark on the moonlit nights; the full moon a cool light, a new moon only stars. Rain as the game's (Game/README Weather): thin pale streaks (4.5 mm), the open paving darker with a faint sheen in half-metre cells, soft-edged dark puddles with a little mirror and faint grey rings; none under a roof or arch. Snow lies only under open sky.
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: "Street needs to have references for all 4 settings morning, mid day, dusk, and night"; rain as the game's ("Yes, both"); ADR-0061; the owner, 2026-11-26: "Approve, next place"; snow as small round balls, the near ones up to 30% smaller (the owner, 2026-11-26)

references.title: A home's room (the living room) at every hour
references.locks: The living of furniture_kit_18, closed on four sides with one window. In the world's light (the owner, 2026-11-26: "use the same color etc from world lighting"): by day only the sun and sky of the hour, through the window, with the sunlit street outside throwing its light in; lamps and the fire out by day; the boards a greyer wood, so the bounced light is not orange; at night the lamps a warm white (until the kinds of light, FURN-066), the fire lit, the full moon a cool patch through the window, a new moon only the window's starlight. No weather settings indoors (the owner). The wall facing the people throws light back onto them (the owner, 2026-11-26: "the wall opposite to the character is not reflecting light back"): by day a little of the day through the window, at night a share of the lamps' light in their colour. Every fire, in every reference, one red (the owner, 2026-11-26: "oven flame should be same color in all references and more red"): its flames glow red and catch no light; with no other light in a room its red takes the room over, as it should (the owner). Two more nights with the fire out as well as the lamps (the owner: "we need reference of moon lights when the fire place is turned off"): the full moon only through the window, dim and cool, a new moon very dark.
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: one home room and the hallway stand for the home's rooms ("just do one room, hall way, shop and cafe"); in the world's light; ADR-0061; the owner, 2026-11-26: "Approve it"; the fire redder and the fire-out nights added, 2026-11-26 (the owner)
references.made_by: Tools/blender/hours_50.py (WASTED_PLACE=rooms WASTED_ONLY=living) on the rooms of Tools/blender/furniture_kit_18.py
issues: The shade is lifted by light bounced more strongly than the surfaces' own colours give (plaster x2, boards x2, the street outside x2.6).
The living room still reads warm at dusk: the fire and the dusk sky together.
The light the facing wall throws back is a hidden soft light on that wall (BOUNCE_CARD in hours_50.py: 25 W by day, 15 % of the lamps by night), not the wall's own bounce, which reached too little.

references.title: A home's hallway by the stairs at every hour
references.locks: A home's hallway (the owner, 2026-11-26: "corridor or near stairs area where there are no direct windows but indirect light coming from room"): a corridor about 1.7 m wide with no window of its own, the stair rising at its far end under a closed stairwell, the hall table, mirror, coat stand and rug along its left wall. By day its only light is the day coming through the open door of the room beside it, whose window faces the sun; at dusk and at night its pendant and the lamp on the hall table, the doorway dark; the full moon a dim, cool blue light from that doorway (the owner, 2026-11-26: as dim as the new moon was, and cooler), a new moon darker still, only the doorway faintly showing. In the world's light, lamps of their kinds (World/rules/lights.json).
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: one home room and the hallway stand for the home's rooms ("just do one room, hall way, shop and cafe"); in the world's light; ADR-0061; the owner, 2026-11-26: "Approve it"

references.title: The bakery's light at every hour (its oven always lit)
references.locks: The Stone Oven bakery (ShopsBakery's design) in the world's light, as the home room: by day the world's sun and sky through its window with the sunlit street outside, its pendants low (as approved by day), the boards a greyer wood, the shade lifted, the wall facing the counter throwing light back; at dusk and at night the pendants full, in their kind's colour (World/rules/lights.json). The oven burns at every hour: a bakery's own light, which other shops do not have. No moonlit nights (the owner: "for bakery, don't need moon settings"), no weather. Every fire, in every reference, one red (the owner, 2026-11-26: "oven flame should be same color in all references and more red"): its flames glow red and catch no light; with no other light in a room its red takes the room over, as it should (the owner).
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: the bakery reviewed at every hour; "bakery has oven so it will be different from bank/grocers and other such outlets"; ADR-0061; the owner, 2026-11-26: "Approve it"

issues: Dusk and the lamp-lit night look nearly alike: once the sun is down the pendants and the oven carry it.

references.title: A shop's floor without a fire (bank, grocer and the like) at every hour
references.locks: A shop's ground floor at the game's size (the owner, 2026-11-26: "take the size from game for bank, grocers or library"): the smallest grocer's lot (Northwood Grocer, 12 m along the street, 11 m deep), 3 m to the ceiling (World/rules/storeys.json); its street side the approved timber shopfront seen from inside (the owner: "take the windows wall references from build models approved previously"; BuildingsTypes, shop_front_a): teal pilasters on stone bases, a stall riser under a stone sill, tall panes with a centre bar and a transom, a glazed door, the fascia, the striped awning outside, rolled up under the fascia in the morning so the low sun comes deep in, out from midday; shelving in rows, the counter and till, a rail, a table, a board, four pendants. In the world's light as the bakery and the home room: by day the sun and sky through the front, the pendants low; at dusk and at night the pendants full in their kind's colour. No fire, no moonlit nights, no weather. It stands for the bank, the grocer, the library and other shops without a fire; the bakery has its own (ShopsBakeryLight).
references.decision: the owner, 2026-11-26: "bakery has oven so it will be different from bank/grocers and other such outlets"; ADR-0061, ADR-0066; the awning rolled up in the morning (the owner: "Rolled up mornings"); the owner, 2026-11-26: "Approve it"
